goal: Prevent invalid wait timeouts from crashing debug nodes or creating bad deadlines
Ensure mining interface callers receive an error when timeouts are negative or NaN
agreement: Strong support because it stops IPC clients from aborting debug builds or setting bad deadlines (ryanofsky)
Nonblocking suggestion to verify that infinite timeouts truly wait rather than return early (ryanofsky)

why: P3 because it defensively hardens the mining interface against node aborts or invalid deadlines
